notes.title: Soulscape: Shadows of The Past (Episode 1)
notes.notes:
This is the first build we are releasing for Soulscape: Shadows of The Past (EP1) but we are going to be constantly updating and working on porting our builds.

Currently we are working on adding different languages such as French and Japanese to our game.

We are so happy to release Soulscape today, Enjoy!
